gather_proto_dependencies: run the GatherProto setuptools command to copy gRPC proto files and create __init__.py files
build_python_package: run the BuildPy command to build the Python package including proto dependencies
run_tests_lite: run the TestLite command to execute tests without fetching or building anything
run_tests_gevent: run the TestGevent command to execute tests with gevent monkey patching enabled
run_interop_client_server: run the RunInterop command to start the interop test client or server with arguments
